export-authoringRules.PURPOSE: Publish immutable task-XXXX, sandbox, provenance, and simulation rules.

M-TASK-TEMPLATE.NAME: TaskTemplate

type-ConciseStudentTaskCard.PURPOSE: Exact ARMY-97 order, starter-only technology-mapped sandbox including pure versus browser-DOM TypeScript routing, controlled five-field metadata, canonical N минут duration, and exact ordinal-link-substantive-sentence-duration thematic row.

M-TASK-VALIDATION.NAME: TaskValidation
M-TASK-VALIDATION.purpose: Own tracked immutable source-audit decisions, current published-catalog state, Markdown editor and collection-row synchronization, derived mutable publication decisions, and causally executed mode-bound exact-commit validation.

type-Army97CandidateRecord.PURPOSE: Neutral source snapshot plus transition-gated publication state.

type-CatalogGateMode.PURPOSE: wave certifies complete cumulative prefixes before cutover; final certifies the strict 118-card catalog and simulations.

type-CardMigrationEvidence.PURPOSE: Nested exact ten-field Beads migration evidence.

type-FullCatalogGateEvidence.PURPOSE: Nested exact nine-field mode-bound receipt emitted only after catalog PASS at current HEAD, bound to the card file in that commit, and re-executed during validation.

export-validateCatalogInventory.PURPOSE: Reject partial waves, noncanonical duration, technology/editor mismatch, collection-row prefixes, suffixes, punctuation-only prose, extra fields, title-description-time drift, missing, duplicate, or format-inconsistent real-work projections, missing or multiple thematic projections, unpublished references, malformed ARMY cards, final inventory drift, or nested provenance before evidence emission.

export-runCatalogGateAtCommit.PURPOSE: Execute the tracked wave or final catalog gate from an isolated exact-commit archive and require the evidence slug in that commit.

export-validatePublicationRegistry.PURPOSE: Derive mutable counts and cross-check published IDs, thematic mapping, Markdown editor profile, evidence, immutable state, and exact-current-commit execution.

export-taskCard.PURPOSE: Expose one accepted immutable student card.
